Policy: a PR is ready only when GitHub's merge state is CLEAN, the check rollup on the head commit is SUCCESS (no failing or still-running check, required or not), no review decision blocks, the PR is not in a merge queue, and the head is the commit the person expects. Use the pr_readiness tool.

NEXT: author | reviewer | wait | unknown | none
